source.title: Proposed categories of bycatch based on an assessment of data from the Anilao Fish Port, Batangas, Philippines
source.citation: Banzon, E. M. H., Padilla, M. I. O., Yan, J. P., & Cruz, R. A. L. (2019). Marine Policy, 100, 1-7.
source.publisherCopyright: Elsevier Ltd, 2018, as stated in the institutional record metadata.

scopeReview.landingSite: Anilao Fish Port, described by the article as the main landing site of municipal fisheries in Balayan Bay.
scopeReview.decision: Keep as historical landing-site evidence only; a fish recorded at the port is not thereby assigned to an exact capture point or the entire Balayan Bay.

rightsReview.decision: No species table or article-derived list is copied or admitted pending an item-specific reuse basis.

nonClaims: The 2016-2017 observations are historical and do not establish current fish presence, abundance, catchability, fishing legality or safety.
The fish-port location and Balayan Bay landing-site context do not establish the capture location of each landed species.
The publisher copyright notice does not grant reuse rights; no item-specific open license was verified.
The 35-species abstract summary is not a complete species list, and no species-level assertions are admitted from it.
